text: In nineteen seventy-nine, NASA dropped a seventy-seven tonne space station on Australia. Australia sent NASA a fine.
Skylab was falling early. The Sun got more active, heated the upper atmosphere, and puffed it up. More air means more drag, so the orbit shrank faster than planned.
It broke up on the way down and scattered debris across Western Australia. Nobody was hurt.
The town of Esperance fined NASA four hundred dollars for littering. It went unpaid for thirty years, until a radio host paid it.
Dave went outside to look for souvenirs.
